canonical_project: Hung Yen Data and Digital Transformation Center (Trung tam Du lieu va Chuyen doi so Hung Yen)
owner: Hung Yen Department of Science and Technology / provincial government
notes: Provincial Decision 47/2025/QD-UBND establishes the Data and Digital Transformation Center under the Department of Science and Technology operating the provincial data/digital infrastructure; Nhan Dan also reports Hung Yen pushing data-infrastructure buildout toward 2030. Public-sector center, not commercial colocation; no MW.
